description:
Record what you grow, watch for, saw, or hold seed for on a plot.

A whole batch in one call, because an afternoon in the field produces
several notes at once and each one should not be its own fare.

block.description: The ground this belongs to — its id, its name, or an alias.

items.description: What to record, as a list. A planting is {crop, gdd_target, set_out}; a pest is a model as pest_threshold takes it; wildlife is an event as wildlife_calendar takes it; an observation is {observed_on, tag, note} plus whatever you saw; a seed lot is {crop, variety, days_to_maturity, germination_pct, tested_on, packed_for, quantity, unit, source, lot}, everything but crop optional. Pass item_id to amend something already recorded.

kind.description: One of: planting, pest, wildlife, observation, seed.

npub.description: Required. Your Nostr public key (npub1...) for credit billing.

retire_ids.description: Ids to retire. They stay readable as history; nothing is deleted.

season.description: The season year these belong to. Defaults to the year of each one's own date. Observations and seed lots belong to no season.

name: goodearth_block_item_save
title: Goodearth Block Item Save
